nhl-2026020154.title: Boston’s record edge needs a goalie check
nhl-2026020154.text: Boston arrive with seven wins from ten games, while Nashville’s official record is three wins, two losses and three overtime losses. That corrects an inherited record discrepancy. The record-only projection favors Boston, but it cannot price the impact of either starting goaltender, injuries or shot quality. Treat the winner line as a research baseline, not a verified moneyline bet.

nhl-2026020162.title: Minnesota lead the baseline, not a finished betslip
nhl-2026020162.text: Minnesota’s 6–2–2 record contrasts with Calgary’s 2–6–0 start. The samples are different lengths, so the model smooths both records before comparing them rather than reading the raw win percentages as head-to-head probabilities. Minnesota are the projected winner. Goalie confirmation and a matching bookmaker settlement remain missing, and no puck line or total is justified by win records alone.

el-r7-04.text: Panathinaikos enter 5–1 against a 1–5 Baskonia side. The official Round 7 preview also notes 73.0 points conceded per game and five consecutive home wins in this matchup. Those facts support the direction of the Panathinaikos projection, not a calibrated success rate. Six league games, unconfirmed availability and no comparable quoted market keep this outside the approved High board.

el-r7-06.title: Belgrade derby: contrasting streaks, limited certainty
el-r7-06.text: Crvena Zvezda bring four consecutive wins into a derby against Partizan, who have lost their last three. Their overall records are 4–2 and 3–3 respectively, as reported by EuroLeague. The independent record baseline leans toward Crvena Zvezda. Derby context, opponent strength and personnel are not quantified here, so the recent streaks are context rather than a license to claim a strong betting edge.

ehf-oct22-3.title: Sporting’s scoring gap comes from just four games
ehf-oct22-3.text: Sporting’s unbeaten 3–1–0 opening record and 149 goals scored compare with Kristianstad’s four defeats and 122 goals. The official table also records 125 conceded by Sporting and 155 by their visitors. The illustrative goal model therefore projects Sporting to win in regulation. Its handicaps and totals are mathematical experiments from a four-game sample, not confirmed available markets or validated High-confidence selections.

ehf-oct22-4.title: Barça’s defense gives the illustrative line its direction
ehf-oct22-4.text: Barça have won all four group games while allowing 104 goals; Montpellier have one win and three defeats, with 116 scored and 125 conceded. These are the paired official inputs behind the regulation projection for Barça. The source does not establish a current injury-adjusted lineup or an executable handicap price. Poisson scoring and the small sample are material weaknesses, so confidence stays Low.

mlb-849805.title: World Series opener: a season baseline, not pitcher analysis
mlb-849805.text: Milwaukee finished the regular season 103–59, scoring 832 runs and conceding 618; Tampa Bay went 98–64 with 736 scored and 650 allowed. That longer sample gives Milwaukee the stronger record-only projection for Game 1. It does not describe postseason momentum or the starting-pitcher matchup. Those missing inputs prevent a credible run line, game total or approved wager.

gaa-cork-final-2026.title: Cork final: verified paths, no invented odds
gaa-cork-final-2026.text: Nemo Rangers reached the final after beating Carrigaline 1–15 to 0–16, having previously beaten Castlehaven 1–20 to 1–17. St Finbarrs advanced with a 2–12 to 0–16 semifinal win over Clonakilty. Cork GAA confirms the Sunday 4pm fixture and venue. These results establish recent history, but not a calibrated draw-aware forecast; the winner and fair-odds fields therefore remain blank.
